title: A singular surface with free tangent sheaf
description: A normal affine complex surface whose module of derivations is free of rank two although the surface is singular, after OpenAI's 2026 counterexample to the Lipman-Zariski conjecture. An explicit elliptic curve on the quadric with a line bundle of order four; a curve of genus 21 with fourth-order contact and a fourth root of its canonical bundle; traces, residues and Grothendieck's splitting theorem; the trace form and the residue data; two vector fields glued order by order near the curve; contraction to a singular point with free derivations; algebraization by finite determinacy with relations.

prerequisites: Kahler differentials, smooth algebras and the Jacobian criterion, regular local rings, Serre's normality criterion, completion, Artin-Rees and henselization (course Commutative algebra for geometry, AG-CA)
cohomology of O(a,b) on P^1 x P^1, Serre duality and the canonical bundle, Serre's theorems and comparison theorems (course Cohomology of quasi-coherent sheaves, AG-QC)
Riemann-Roch for smooth projective curves (course The abstract theory of ideals, NOE-ABS, lesson 6, Theorem 4.3)
holomorphic functions of several variables, coherence, the analytic Nullstellensatz, Theorems A and B on Stein manifolds (course Complex analytic spaces and coherent sheaves)
